## Features, Traits & Notes

**Class Features (Wizard):** Wizard: Ritual Adept, Wizard: Spellcasting, Wizard: Arcane Recovery, Wizard: Scholar, Wizard: Wizard Subclass, Feat — Background: Magic Initiate (Wizard)
**Species Traits (Tortle):**
- **Claws.** You are able to make unarmed strikes with your claws, dealing 1d4 slashing damage on a hit, and you have a climbing speed of 15 feet.
- **Hold Breath.** You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour at a time.
- **Natural Armor.** Your shell provides a base Armor Class of 17 (your Dexterity modifier applies, to a maximum of +2). You can't wear light, medium, or heavy armor, though this doesn't affect your ability to use a shield.
- **Nature's Intuition.** You have proficiency in one skill of your choice from the following list: Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, or Survival.
- **Shell Defense.** You can withdraw into your shell as an action. Until you emerge, you gain a +4 bonus to AC, you have advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws, and you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, can't move, and are prone. Emerging from your shell requires an action.
- **Languages.** Common, Aquan
